extension.summary: EPGStation の録画を閲覧・再生
extension.description: Lists recordings from an EPGStation 2.x server with full EPG information (description, extended info, genres, channel, broadcast time) and plays them directly.
EPGStation 2.x サーバーの録画を番組情報（概要・詳細・ジャンル・放送局・放送日時）付きで一覧表示し、直接再生します。
extension.news: v0.3.0 (2026-10-13) - Recording details: a 【録画情報】 block with channel, air time, video/audio format, files with sizes, drop/error counts, protection and encoding state; ドロップログ viewer when a recording has drops - ファイルを削除: delete one video file of a recording (e.g. the TS after an encode) and keep the others - ジャンル別 counts every genre a recording has, and genres open into subgenre folders with counts - English genre names now include subgenres; dubbed movies show the voice actor as "Dub: name" - The KODIstation Repository moves to GitHub Pages (https://myfeethurt.github.io/kodistation/); source on GitHub
